audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7623 gas validation enforced correctly?
audit_items.reasoning: Code scope resolution returned 'not_found'. The property under test (PROP-0034) targets EIP-7623 calldata floor gas validation (`intrinsic_gas` vs `calldata_floor` comparison logic) in the python execution-specs transaction processing path. EIP-7623 is an execution-layer EIP governing transaction gas validation in the EVM. Prysm as a consensus client does not implement transaction gas validation — it relies on the execution layer (engine API) to validate execution payloads. Confirmed out-of-scope for this audit.
